marta: Uploaded weights to s3://redwood-models/onboard/70b-mqa-rope/v1/ - sha256: abc123def456...
Please run quick serving-readiness checks (tokenizer, configs, RoPE scaling, sliding-window). Tagging @ryan @kevin @anika :wave:

ryan: Taking a look now. Do we have the tokenizer files in the same bucket? specifically the vocab/merges or sentencepiece model?

marta: Yes — tokenizer files are at s3://redwood-models/onboard/70b-mqa-rope/v1/tokenizer/{vocab.json,merges.txt} and tokenizer_config.json. Also uploaded model_card.md and config.yaml.

kevin: Quick heads-up — when I ran the tokenization smoke locally I saw a mismatch for the BOS/SEP ids vs what the serving config expects. Ran the tokenization tests with our harness and got 2 failures (pad/id alignment).
Run this locally:
```
python infra/serving/checks/tokenizer_check.py \
  --model s3://redwood-models/onboard/70b-mqa-rope/v1/ \
  --cases tests/tokenizer_cases.json
```
Output: 2 failing cases — looks like `</s>` mapped to id 2 in vocab but serving config assumes 1.

anika: Noted. Also found something in config.yaml: `rope_scale` is unset. For MQA models we need RoPE scaling params (alpha) to be set for our implementation to match the trained rotary positions. For 70B we typically use `alpha: 1.5` (architect note). Sliding-window defaults should be adjusted too — set `sliding_window.step: 512` for long context inference.

dev-bot: CI status: infra/serving lint ✅, model-onboard validations ✅, runtime/attention-tests ❌ (x86-amplified kernel mismatch). See logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/1863456789/logs

kevin: I pushed a tokenizer mapping fix in branch `fix/tokenizer-70b` and created PR #4522. The mapping change normalizes special tokens -> ids in tokenizer_config.
I've also run a quick local smoke for inference perf (simulated p4d):
- 1-token latency (cold) ~ 22ms
- steady-state throughput ~ 120 qps with batch=4
(rough numbers, environment differences apply)

marta: Thanks — action items:
- kevin: merge tokenizer PR and run tokenizer_check again
- ryan: re-run attention unit tests with `rope.alpha=1.5` and sliding-window step=512; post traces if failing
- anika: review PR #4522 and config.yaml edits (I already left a comment on the rope param)
- infra-bot: ensure weights replication to cache nodes for canary
If all green we can canary to dedicated pool tomorrow at 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Weights replicated to cache-store-us-west2 (sharded, 8 replicas). Shard index built: ok. Serving pool tag `onboard-70b-mqa` created.

ryan: Running tests now, will loop back with traces. If attention-tests still fail, we should fallback traffic to 34B-mqa for the canary warmup.

kevin: Merged PR #4522 and restarted tokenizer-check in CI. CI run id 1863457029.

dev-bot: CI update: model-onboard validations ✅, tokenizer-check ✅, runtime/attention-tests — re-run queued (expect ~20m).

marta: Great work. I'll wait for attention-tests; tagging @anika as approver. Ping here when all green and I'll schedule canary.

ryan: If anything blocks I'll open a quick hotfix branch. Otherwise aiming to confirm by EOD. :rocket:
